description_for_human: Soluções sanitárias por tipo de negócio: aulas, pastas prontas, vistorias e consultoria para alimentação, estética e beleza, saúde e ILPI.
description_for_model: Institutional site for TreinaVISA, a Brazilian sanitary hub founded by Ester Caiafa (sanitary nurse). It combines education and services: live classes and courses, ready-made sanitary document folders, inspections (vistoria), personalized folders and consulting, organized by business type (food service, aesthetics and beauty, health clinics, long-term care for the elderly/ILPI). Services are delivered by Consultora Sanitária (Ester Caiafa, www.consultorasanitaria.com.br) and nutritionist Ana Roberta Ribeiro (food service). Partner: Rosalia Cova, nutritionist with more than 20 years of sanitary inspection experience. Full summary at https://www.treinavisa.com.br/llms.txt. Language: Brazilian Portuguese.
